svg.text: Orb's minimum (two cities, several towns, a few biomes) against today's hand-made arena, both drawn to scale at 153,600 units.
Today: one city, three villages, five biomes (hand-made, the same every fight)
Proposed: a slice of the generated planet (2 cities, 4 towns, 4 biomes, 70% land)
How long should the arena be?
about 1.4 cities, 1.7 towns: cannot meet two
cities unless cities shrink to half
the minimum (92% of touch-downs, the rest
about 5.8 cities, 7 towns: room to spare
What does not change with the arena: the sim still steps the same few hundred things. Today's 118 buildings sit on 46,000 settled units (2.6 per 1,000);
a slice that is 34% settled has about 52,000 settled units, so about 134 buildings: the same order. Crowds, windows and lanes are drawn only near the camera.
The cost that grows is the planet: places and the optional cache (4x the area for 2x the length). An old laptop and the web build pay once, at touch-down.
A fight uses a few thousand units around T. The rest of the circle is where the lure, a launch or a loser's flight takes them.
